entries.reason: Retired in mcp_tax_v1.2: TLS handshake books MSG_TRANSPORT_CPU (provenance transport_tls_handshake). MSG_VALIDATE is JSON Schema validation only so the DFA amenability claim is not crypto-contaminated.

entries.claim: MCP-01 TurnTrace echo is protocol method-dispatch dominance (MSG_DISPATCH)
entries.reason: Retired after v8 provenance: client DISPATCH is ~99.5–99.8% client_call_inter_region_gaps; true method lookup / result routing is only a few µs/msg. The surviving cross-instrument echo is diffuseness of unattributed inter-region cost, not dispatch silicon. Quoting floor-class 2–3 ms/msg tax before gap attribution repeats the Phase-1 headline mistake.

entries.claim: Binding diffuseness verdict from WSL seed-0 / n<3 smoke
entries.reason: Retired by mcp_tax_v1.4.1 verdict_min_population: binding audit.diffuseness_verdict requires >=20 measured messages and >=3 seeds. Below the floor the classifier emits deferred_insufficient_population with advisory_only only — WSL seed-0 cannot return a binding verdict.

entries.claim: gap_unattributed >50% of parent gap triggers diffuseness refuted
entries.reason: Retired by mcp_tax_v1.5 amendment: confirm/refute evaluate over named mechanisms (a)–(d) only. gap_unattributed above unattributed_forces_inconclusive_share (0.20) forces inconclusive — residual is unmeasured, not a concentrated fixable mechanism. v9 advisory incorrectly returned refuted on dominant (e); the population floor prevented a binding mistake.

entries.claim: Instrumented raw stdio FRAME includes a second request-side json.loads of harness-canonical bytes
entries.reason: Authenticity Axis 5 (mcp01_authenticity_audit.md): the harness already materializes canonical JSON-RPC via canonical_json_bytes / MessageStep.canonical_bytes. Re-decoding and json.loads inside FRAME before the pipe write was redundant inauthentic work no honest protocol peer would redo on bytes it just produced. Removed on the instrumented path only (newline check retained); untrusted/external callers and response-side validation still run full _validate_stdio_message. Justification is authenticity (Axis 5 FLAGGED → fix), not a performance shortcut independent of that finding.
evidence: transports/stdio.py: instrumented exchange skips request json.loads; response still fully validated
Affected category: MSG_FRAME (transport_frame provenance) on raw stdio — not MSG_VALIDATE (schema) and not MSG_SERIAL (canonical materialize remains)
COMPARABILITY: any v10 vs v9-era stdio MSG_FRAME table must note this category definition change; a FRAME drop is definitional until stated otherwise

entries.claim: G6 95% single-category FAIL applies even when the dominant category has named provenance >= 80%
entries.reason: Retired by v10.1: g6_single_category_requires_opaque=true, scoped so only directly-timed named work (not g6_gap_fill_provenance) exempts. Axis 5 profiling of stdio @ 512 KiB found FileIO.readline under bufsize=0 issued median 524378 one-byte read() syscalls vs theoretical minimum 9 (pipe 64 KiB); fixed via capacity-sized os.read loop (_read_framed_line). Post-fix profile: median ~9–11 syscalls, LEAN. Post-fix Q3: transport_read remained dominant (~98% of TRANSPORT) — concentration is pipe-read physics, not leftover byte-at-a-time debt. Amendment kept with this evidence; gap-fill labels still FAIL the 95% detector.
evidence: post-fix profile + Q3 remeasure: concentration persists in transport_read at theoretical-min syscalls

policy: Append-only. Retire unsupported claims or arms with evidence; never delete prior entries.
